key_insight: Enhanced state features and reward shaping improve deep reinforcement learning flow control across synthetic jet positions, achieving 8–34% drag reduction at Reynolds numbers of 100–400.
engineering_relevance: More adaptive synthetic jet control could reduce drag and actuation energy while suppressing lift and vortex shedding.
method: Evaluate baseline deep reinforcement learning across Reynolds numbers and synthetic jet positions.
Enhance dynamic state features to improve control decisions.
Reshape the reward function to support multiple control objectives.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 8–34% drag reduction over Reynolds numbers of 100–400 and improved performance across jet positions with the optimized framework.
watch_item: Performance at higher Reynolds numbers and in practical deployments is not established by the abstract.
paper_title: Toward fully stabilized flow control using deep reinforcement learning
